scope: optimistic cost projection for the existing Beaver gated-product and 8-bit FSS exact-rescale reference; no compiled share-resident decoder
limitations: Counts only one Beaver gated product and one exact FSS rescale per semantic MLP output; norms, SiLU, attention, other truncations, metadata and checkpoint transfer add cost.
This is a lower bound for the bounded reference construction, not an information-theoretic lower bound for all two-party inference methods.
The checked semantic schedule is unprotected float32 execution; fixed-scale numeric parity and a compiler-bound two-party executor are absent.

Offset comparator comes from a separate single-response cold loopback measurement with matching model, token counts, and baseline composition; projected MPC material and body bytes were not transported or measured on a wire.
